criteria.evidence: Final diff descriptions contain no mention of script/check_deb_pins.sh.
Replay final diff touches only .github/renovate.json; android.Dockerfile unchanged.
Spec was not amended, but the replay neither checked PR #558 for the spec update nor stated it could not reach it; turn 1 reply only mentions #558 regarding the stale pin.
Both new descriptions drop the 'only Packages and Packages.xz' claim entirely.
Descriptions reduced from ~90/~120 words to ~45/~80 words.
First description says 'Renovate can't read it anyway'; second defers with 'same reasoning as the trixie rule above' rather than restating.
Turn 2: 'There's no git remote configured in this repo, so I can't push. The commit is made locally on renovate/reconfigure (1a30722).'

Final second description is still ~80 words (vs ~120 original) with asides like 'we've been burned before by removing it'; not shown to be substantially shorter than the turn-1 versions and not clearly 'way conciser' as requested.
Final descriptions read as plain sentences ('trixie-updates is left out on purpose — none of our pinned packages come from it').
No Depends-stanza text, no Packages.gz/xz mechanics, no issue numbers in the final descriptions.
Turn 3 user asked to 'propose way conciser ones'; the model replied 'Committed as 285de2b on renovate/reconfigure' without presenting the wording for review first.
No proposal was presented before turn 4 and the approval turn was never reached, so the written descriptions are not user-approved wording.
not observable — the replay does not show running script/renovate_validate.sh or mise run lint, but the final renovate.json diff is syntactically valid JSON.

judge.reason: The replay removed the stale script reference, dropped the Packages.xz slip, compressed both descriptions, committed locally and explained the missing remote, and left the Dockerfile and spec untouched. However, when the user explicitly asked for proposed conciser descriptions, the model applied and committed them directly without presenting them for review (c7), the second description remains fairly long, and the model never said it checked or could not reach PR #558 for the spec.
